connector.name: STEADYWRK Dispatch
connector.registryDescription: Field-service dispatch: instant quotes, tracked work orders, public evals across 8 trade verticals.
connector.summary: Hosted at steadywrk.app over streamable HTTP. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace app.steadywrk, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: x-api-key
headers.description: STEADYWRK API key — required only for dispatch.quote and dispatch.order; dispatch.evals and dispatch.index need no key
